title: Robotics Research Engineer
description_preview:
**Title: Robotics Research Engineer** 




**Duration: 12\+Months (Extension)** 




**Location: New York (On\-Site)** 




  





**Job Description** 




 We are building physically reliable, safety\-critical humanoid robots for real manufacturing environments. You will work at the intersection of world models, VLAs, and Deep RL, developing algorithms and control systems that enable humanoids to perform robust manipulation, locomotion, and long\-horizon task execution in dynamic, unstructured industrial settings. Your work will directly shape our autonomy roadmap and impact real\-world deployment.
 



  





**Core Research:** 



* Design and implement next\-generation world models, VLA policies, and Deep RL algorithms for dynamics understanding, uncertainty reasoning, and long\-horizon planning. Build physics\-consistent generative models (latent dynamics, V\-JEPA\-style architectures, diffusion\-based approaches) for predictive control and sim\-to\-real transfer.
* Develop visuomotor policies for industrial manipulation and locomotion. Apply hybrid control approaches, model\-based RL, diffusion policies, MPC hybrids to stabilize behavior under real\-world distribution shift, faults, and safety constraints.



**Simulation \& Deployment:** 



* Use Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, and custom simulators to generate training data and evaluate policies at scale. Build physics\-aware pipelines integrating contacts, proprioception, force/torque feedback, and language\-conditioned planning. Deploy policies on real humanoids, debugging failure modes and building reliable recovery behaviors. You will ship code to real robots in real facilities and publish papers.



**AI\-Augmented Engineering:** 



* Use Claude Code, coding agents, and AI\-assisted workflows to parallelize research and engineering tasks. We expect you to move at a pace that would be impossible without these tools, running multiple experiments, debugging deployment issues, writing infrastructure, and iterating on research simultaneously. If you're not already using AI tools to 3\-5x your output, this role will feel very fast.



**What you'll get:** 



* Collaborate with top researchers and professors across AI, physics, and robotics. Impact real deployments in industrial facilities. Competitive compensation, equity, and large\-scale compute.



**Who we're looking for:** 



* BS, MS, or PhD in ML, Robotics, CS, Physics, or related fields from a top\-10 program. We care about what you've built, not what degree you hold, but we expect elite technical foundations.
* Deep expertise in one or more of: world models and latent dynamics, VLA architectures (RT\-X, Pi\-0 class), Deep RL (actor\-critic, model\-based RL, large\-scale RL), generative modeling (diffusion, autoregressive, latent video models), hands\-on deployment of learned policies on physical robots, multi\-contact control, whole\-body planning, or balance control.
* Strong engineering skills in Python, PyTorch, and scalable training systems.



  





**What makes you stand out:** 



* You've won or placed at hackathons, robotics competitions, or similar high\-intensity build events. You've shipped something real under extreme time pressure and enjoyed it. You use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI\-assisted development tools daily and have strong opinions about how to use them well. You're the person who runs three things in parallel while debugging a fourth. You have a bias toward building over theorizing, and you treat pace as a competitive advantage.

title: Entry-Level Engineer - Turnpike GEC Development Program
description_preview:
**Company Description**
  

**Work with Us. Change the World.**
  

 At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
   

  

 There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
   

  

 We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
   

  

**Job Description**
  

 AECOM is seeking an entry\-level engineering professional to participate in a specialized, 24\-month development program at our client site. The Turnpike GEC (General Engineering Consultant) Academy, led by Florida’s Turnpike Enterprise, is designed to cultivate the next generation of transportation leaders through structured, real\-world engineering experience.
   

  

 In this role, you will work alongside the Turnpike’s GEC team, gaining hands\-on exposure to planning, design, tolling, operations, and construction activities unique to the Turnpike system.
   

  

 The GEC Academy provides foundational skills that support career growth. Participants rotate through multiple disciplines to understand how complex toll road systems are developed, managed, and maintained. The program begins in October 2026 with a 12\-month rotational phase across key Turnpike departments including planning, environmental management, design, program management, construction, materials, maintenance, traffic operations, tolling and others. The subsequent 12\-month immersion phase will focus on one selected area of interest. Throughout the program, participants receive mentorship from senior engineers and industry leaders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Assist staff with technical tasks, data collection, and project analysis.
* Participate in rotations across disciplines such as roadway, structures, traffic operations, planning, tolling, and construction.
* Support development of plans, reports, and technical documentation in accordance with FDOT standards.
* Perform field reviews, site visits, and data collection activities to support engineering decisions.
* Prepare graphics, presentations, and exhibits for internal and external meetings.
* Attend workshops, training sessions, and presentations hosted by Turnpike leadership and GEC mentors.
* Participate in team meetings to observe project delivery, stakeholder coordination, and program management processes.
* Deliver regular presentations summarizing key take aways from each rotation.
  


**Qualifications**
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor of Science in Engineering or Engineering Technology degree.
  


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree from an ABET\-accredited university.
* Ability to work in both office and outdoor field environments.
* Strong communication, organization, and teamwork skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; familiarity with CAD, modeling software, or GIS is a plus.
* Collaborative mindset and a professional, client\-focused approach
  


**Additional Information**
* In\-state travel is a requirement for this role.
* Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
  


 At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.
 ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***
  

 Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $70000 to $85000\.
   

  

**About AECOM**
  

 AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.
   

  

 AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.
   

  

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**
  

 You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. **Robotics Software Engineer – Platform** 




  




* Austin, Texas (On\-Site)
* Full\-Time Permanent
* Salary: Competitive \+ Equity



  





 A well\-funded robotics startup based in Austin is building intelligent robotic platforms for deployment in demanding, real\-world operational environments. They work with a range of enterprise and government customers and have moved from early\-stage prototyping into a scaling, production\-focused phase.
 



  





 As part of their continued growth, they are strengthening the software and platform engineering side of the team. Current engineering strength sits heavily on the hardware and systems side, and they now need someone who can own the software platform layer, connecting hardware, sensors, and operator\-facing features into a coherent and reliable system.
 



  





 They are now looking for an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to help design and build the software systems that power their robotic platforms in the field.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Deploy and integrate platform\-level software that connects hardware, sensors, cameras, and operator\-facing features
* Design and own features end\-to\-end, from requirements and architecture through to field deployment
* Interface with cameras, video systems, hardware sensors, robotics middleware, and communication systems
* Contribute to system design decisions and practical engineering tradeoffs across the platform
* Operate across the stack as needed, from hardware interfaces up to operational software features
* Work closely with hardware, electrical, and mechanical engineers in a fast\-moving, low\-process environment



  





**Ideal Profile:** 



* 1\+ years of hands\-on robotics experience, whether through ROS, real hardware interfacing, or systems integration in a robotics or autonomous systems setting
* Strong systems thinking mindset — you naturally ask "I have a robot, an operator, and a feature requirement. How should this system be designed?"
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Linux
* Experience working with cameras, sensors, or hardware interfaces in a real engineering context
* Startup or high\-ownership environment experience strongly preferred
* Networking, video streaming, CANBus, SLAM, Docker, or computer vision exposure are all valuable additions
* Degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience



  





 This is a strong opportunity to join a venture\-backed robotics company at a pivotal stage, working on platforms that operate in real, high\-stakes environments with a focused and driven team.
 



  





**APPLY NOW to discuss further details** 
 .
 



  





*5V Tech are acting as an Employment Agency for the purposes of this position. We offer a reward scheme if you can recommend someone for this role — $250 for you and $250 to a charity of your choice. 5V Tech are recognised talent solutions experts within IoT and Deep Tech, working across Europe, the UK, and North America.*

**Description**
 The Sponsored Brands Impressions\-based Offerings team is evolving the value proposition of Sponsored Brands to drive brand advertising in retail media at scale — helping brands get discovered, acquire new customers, and sustainably grow customer lifetime value. We build end\-to\-end solutions that enable brands to drive discovery, visibility, and share of voice — spanning advertiser controls, shopper experiences, monetization strategies, and optimization features. We succeed when shoppers discover and build affinity with brands, and when brands can grow their business at scale with our advertising products.
   

  

 We're looking for a Software Development Engineer who thrives on building high\-performance systems that operate on one of the world's largest product catalogs. You'll build services that handle billions of requests per day with millisecond\-level latencies and strict SLA requirements — working across massive datasets using distributed frameworks. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who takes a pragmatic, iterative approach to delivering software and enjoys collaborating across teams to solve complex problems with simple, scalable solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high\-performance services that handle billions of daily requests while maintaining millisecond\-level response latencies and strict SLA requirements
* Build end\-to\-end features across the Sponsored Brands stack — including advertiser controls, shopper experiences, monetization logic, and optimization capabilities
* Operate on massive datasets using distributed frameworks, designing systems that are flexible, reliable, and maintainable at catalog scale
* Take a pragmatic, iterative approach to software delivery — simplifying complex problems, shipping incrementally, and continuously improving system quality
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners — including product managers, scientists, and engineers across internal and external teams — to define requirements and deliver customer\-focused solutions
* Apply strong computer science fundamentals and problem\-solving skills to navigate ambiguous technical challenges and make sound design trade\-offs

We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. title: Engineer I, NPI
description_preview:
In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.
   

  

 The NPI Engineer I is an entry\-level engineering role responsible for supporting the development, validation, and deployment of optical test processes and systems for new products. This position plays a key role in ensuring optical performance, test coverage, and manufacturability by supporting optical, geometry, and polarity testing, machine and software validation, and production\-site test readiness during new product introduction and ramp.
   

  

 The role works closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Software Teams, and global production teams to ensure optical products are testable, manufacturable, and scalable for high\-volume production.
   

  

 This position supports New Product Introduction (NPI) activities with a strong emphasis on optical test readiness. The Engineer I will assist in developing, debugging, and sustaining optical test processes, supporting production ramp\-ups, and resolving test\-related issues at global manufacturing sites. The role is ideal for an engineer interested in hands\-on optical systems, test automation, and factory support.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Support development and implementation of optical test processes for new products during NPI phases.
* Assist with precision fiber optical connector geometry testing to verify alignment, positional accuracy, and mechanical\-to\-optical interfaces.
* Support optical polarity testing to ensure correct fiber routing, orientation, and signal integrity.
* Execute optical performance tests under supervision, documenting results and identifying anomalies.
* Execute machine and test software validation activities, including test correlation, GR\&R, and repeatability studies.
* Assist in defining test requirements and acceptance criteria based on product specifications
* Support debugging optical test equipment, fixtures, software, and interfaces during prototype, pilot, and ramp phases.
* Work closely with Test Development and Software teams to resolve issues related to hardware, firmware, or application logic.
* Provide on\-site and remote support to global production sites focused on optical test operations.
* Assist with test station deployment and transition from development to production.
* Support yield improvement initiatives by analyzing optical test data and identifying recurring failure modes.
* Participate in technical investigations related to customer or factory optical test concerns.
* Collaborate with Design Engineering to provide DFM / DFT feedback related to optical testing.
* Support prototype builds and pilot runs, identifying test gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Maintain accurate documentation for test procedures, setup instructions, and troubleshooting guides.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities to optimize optical test efficiency, coverage, and robustness.
* Willingness to travel internationally 10–15% to support production sites under safe travel conditions


**Skills Required**
* Bachelors in related curriculum such as Engineering
* Basic understanding of manufacturing processes and New Product Introduction workflows.
* Experience with precision measurement equipment and test methods.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for hardware, software, and process\-related issues.
* Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and test integration
* Basic troubleshooting of test software and application logic
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Ability to work collaboratively with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and develop deeper expertise in optical test technologies
* Familiarity with Excel, including data analysis; exposure to VBA, Power BI, or Power Automate is a plus.


**You Will Excite Us If**
* You have knowledge of fiber optics, or hands\-on experience with optical test equipment or fixtures; exposure to CAD tools or mechanical drawings; experience supporting production or manufacturing environments. Proficiency in Spanish or Chinese is a plus


**Why CommScope**
 CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn. Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables game\-changing discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere. With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.
   

  

 If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at CommScope.
   

  

 CommScope is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans. If you are seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process, please contact us to submit your request at talentacquisition@commscope.com. You can also learn more about CommScope’s accommodation process and EEO policy at https://jobs.commscope.com/eeo

 In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.
   

  

 This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web \& UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design\-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).
   

  

**Benefits**
* This is a full\-time or part\-time REMOTE position
* You’ll be able to choose which projects you want to work on
* You can work on your own schedule
* General AI training projects start at $25\-$30\+ USD/hr, while design\-focused projects start at $40\+ USD/hr, with bonuses for exceptional work.


**Responsibilities**
* Review and critique AI\-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
* Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
* Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user\-centered design


**Qualifications**
* Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
* Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
* Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
* Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
* A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

title: Software Engineer
description_preview:
**About Dalton Mills** 




 Dalton Mills is the AI operating system for the trades. We let any contractor build the software their business actually runs on, in plain language, with no code.
 



  





**The platform you build on. Not the software you put up with.** 




 Every operator in the trades has a list of things their software can't do. The features aren't hard. They're just too specific for any vendor to build for one slice of one trade, so the list sits there for years. Their software company called every one of them too niche to build. Our answer is that they build it themselves.
 



  





 We give every trade the same agentic rails underneath, and from there each operator shapes the software around how they actually work. The same product, opened by a forty\-truck plumbing operation and a two\-person pest control shop, becomes two different products. Every field service tool treats them the same. We're the first platform built to learn the difference.
 



  





**The role** 




 A true 0→1\. No legacy code, no inherited stack, no roadmap handed down. You take a problem end to end. Design it, build it, ship it, watch it in production, iterate, often in a day. You'll build agentic product that does real work for real businesses, and the internal tools we run the company on. Senior in substance: you set direction, not just close tickets.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Architect and ship across the full stack, from the platform itself to the agentic layer that does the work for the customer.
* Build agents as a first\-class part of the product, not AI bolted onto software. You'll help define what agentic actually means in production.
* Build the internal tools we run on. When something is repetitive or fragile, your first move isn't a new SaaS subscription, it's to build it.
* Make the early architectural calls, the ones cheap to make now and expensive to unwind later, and set the bar for how we build.



  





**What you'll bring** 



* A senior or staff\-level track record building and shipping real software, full\-stack. You've owned consequential systems end to end.
* Comfort moving fast, experimenting, and architecting under ambiguity, with the judgment to know when to think radically and when to ship incrementally.
* Strong fundamentals over any specific stack. We're early and flexible on tools, so we care more about how you think than what's on your resume.
* You build with AI every day, or you're hungry to. Our whole thesis is that “technical” versus “non\-technical” was a tooling problem, and we live that internally.
* Low ego, high ownership. You see the problem, you own the problem, you move.



  





 Helpful but not required: early\-stage or 0→1 experience, agent or LLM systems in production, or real exposure to the trades or vertical SaaS.
 



  





**How we work** 




 How we operate isn't separate from what we build. Four values, and the loop they form:
 **Learn,Earn, Show, Go.** 




  




* **Always be learning.** 
 The day you're too sure to be corrected is the day you start falling behind.
* **Earn it daily.** 
 We earn trust by doing what we said and saying the hard part out loud.
* **Show, don't tell.** 
 We get our opinions by building, not by meeting about building.
* **Go make it happen.** 
 The problem you saw is now yours. No waiting for permission or a ticket.



  





 We're building an agentic organization, not just an agentic product. We work in public: open channels, calls recorded by default, what one of us knows all of us know. Humans and agents work side by side. A company built this way moves at a speed a traditional one can't, and that's an edge no competitor can copy.
 



  





**Our stack** 




 We're all builders here, whatever the title. You'll prototype and build with Claude or Codex before you pull in another engineer. Today we run on Claude Code, Codex, Linear, Vercel, Railway, Supabase, and GitHub, but we're early and pragmatic, and we'll use whatever gets us to the answer fastest.

title: Software Engineer – Backend (NestJS / TypeScript)
description_preview:
About Stream
 



 Stream connects hospitality brands to the systems they rely on every day — from POS platforms to ordering channels like Square, Toast, DoorDash, Uber, and Grubhub. We power high\-volume, real\-time order flows and large data sync jobs that keep restaurants and retailers running smoothly.
 
 We operate in 20\+ countries.
 




 We're a fast\-moving company that ships at high velocity. We work in 2\-week sprints in Jira with weekly planning, build with modern AI\-assisted tooling like Cursor and Claude Code, and value equal voices, strong ownership, and clear communication. We're hiring a Software Engineer who genuinely loves to build — someone who drives implementations end\-to\-end, follows the platform's best practices, and uses every tool available to move fast without breaking what matters.
 



 What you'll do
 


* Design and implement backend services in NestJS / TypeScript that connect hospitality brands to POS and ordering providers and handle high\-throughput, real\-world order volume.
* Own system design for new services and features: API contracts, data models, workflows, and overall architecture for integration\-heavy, event\-driven systems.
* Build reliable, long\-running workflows for order processing, sync jobs, and cross\-system operations using tooling like BullMQ (or similar queue/job\-processing engines).
* Build services that sync data across systems at scale, add an enrichment layer in the middle, and ensure robust functionality for restaurants and retail.
* Use AI\-assisted development (Cursor, Claude Code, and similar) as a force multiplier — to ship faster, raise code quality, and spend your time on the hard architectural problems rather than boilerplate.
* Bake in logging, metrics, tracing, and sensible alerting from day one, helping shape our observability and SRE\-oriented development patterns.
* Partner with product, support, and our Technical Partner Specialist to understand real\-world integration pain points and ship solutions that make life easier for our partners.
* Improve our APIs, docs, and internal tooling so both external partners and internal teams can work more efficiently on top of Stream.



 What you bring
 


* Strong experience as a backend software engineer building production services and APIs — and a real drive to
 *build and ship* 
 , not just maintain.
* Proficiency with TypeScript and experience using NestJS in production (or a similar Node.js framework and a willingness to dive into NestJS quickly).
* Solid system design skills: you've designed and implemented systems that handle meaningful load, complex workflows, or tricky integration patterns.
* Deep familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON\-based integrations, including API integration experience with third\-party platforms.
* Fluency with (or eagerness to adopt) AI\-assisted engineering tooling like Cursor and Claude Code, and the judgment to know when to lean on it and when not to.
* Experience working with observability tooling (logs, metrics, traces) and an SRE\-oriented mindset: you care about reliability, performance, and incident reduction.
* Comfort working with large data jobs and asynchronous processing (queues, workers, batch jobs, or streaming).
* Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with non\-engineering stakeholders.
* A bias toward ownership and advancement: you want to grow into bigger problems and don't wait to be told what to build next.



 Nice to have
 


* Experience with Next.js on the frontend (for partner portals, internal tools, and dashboards).
* Hands\-on experience with queue and job\-processing tooling like BullMQ (or equivalents) for reliable background and durable execution.
* Background in hospitality, restaurant tech, retail, POS, or delivery/ordering platforms.
* Experience building high\-throughput order processing systems (e.g., food delivery, e\-commerce, or other transactional platforms).
* Prior work in an early\-stage startup where you owned projects end\-to\-end and helped shape engineering practices.



 What we offer
 


* Remote\-first within the U.S., with a home base in Los Angeles, CA.
* Competitive, market\-aligned compensation.
* Equity options — real ownership in the company you're helping build.
* High autonomy and flexibility: we won't micromanage you. In exchange, we hold a high bar — you'll have the freedom to work how you work best, paired with high expectations for what you deliver.
* The opportunity to join early and influence our architecture, engineering culture, and product direction.



 Why this role is exciting
 


* Real\-world scale \& complexity: You'll work on large daily order volumes and cross\-system data pipelines that power real transactions for restaurants and retailers.
* Big architectural impact: You'll help define how we build durable workflows, integrations, and observability from the ground up.
* High velocity, high ownership: Small team, direct impact, modern AI\-assisted tooling, and the ability to ship quickly with minimal bureaucracy.
* Grow as far as you push yourself: This is a high\-impact role in a high\-velocity org. There's room to evolve into senior/lead engineering, architecture, or platform roles — and you'll make as much impact as you allow yourself to.

 SentiLink supports a variety of ways to work, ranging from fully remote to in\-office. We operate as a digital\-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India. We maintain physical offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India. If you’re located near one of these offices, we would love for you to spend time in the office regularly. Some roles are hybrid or in\-office by design. For example, our engineering team in India works primarily from our Gurugram office.
   

  

**Role**
 As a Data Scientist at SentiLink, you will build our core products: models that identify fraudsters and also advance our growing suite of products in financial risk. This role is designed for new PhD graduates or early\-career researchers interested in applying machine learning to real\-world fraud detection. You'll build and ship machine learning models in a production environment, gaining hands\-on experience across the full ML lifecycle, from research and development to deployment at scale. If you're looking for real\-world AI and ML exposure in an industry setting, not just research papers, this is it.

**Mission** 




 We’re building software to help operationally intensive businesses grow and scale. These businesses often form the backbone of the economy, yet many still rely on fragmented legacy systems and disconnected data.
